category_title: Mature students with depression and insomnia focused on vocational progression
scenario_title: Anxiety about attendance and potential relapse
minimal_context: Colin is reviewing his upcoming attendance schedule for the specialized cookery course to prepare for his progression to a mainstream painting and decorating course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Colin, please fill out this attendance schedule for the next month of the cookery course so we can plan your progression to the intensive painting and decorating course.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know if I can commit to writing down every day. I've been suffering from severe insomnia and depression for the past year.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to make sure you come to class regularly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I do want to progress onto the mainstream course, but I have a real fear of relapsing and subsequently not being able to finish the course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try your best to wake up on time and get here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's not that simple. I was worried about not being regular… about going into some kind of slide and not getting off my bottom and getting out and doing it …and that I might tail off.
